dataset_id_range_claim.note: Dates are from the committed dataset identifier. The manifest says encrypted_only=true; actual decrypted timestamp coverage has not been verified. Missing coverage fails closed; dates must not be shifted post-result.

INTRA_30M_UP_DOWN.target: direction of NIFTY spot simple return from forecast decision price to the price 30 minutes later
INTRA_30M_UP_DOWN.session_rule: decision and horizon-end timestamps must both lie inside the same official trading session; no overnight carry
INTRA_30M_UP_DOWN.flat_rule: exclude rows with absolute simple return <= 1e-8; count exclusions by fold and source
INTRA_30M_UP_DOWN.missing_target_rule: exclude missing decision/target price rows and report count; gate BLOCK if >1.0% of session-eligible rows lack the target pair

POS_1D_UP_DOWN.target: direction of next-trading-session close-to-close NIFTY spot return
POS_1D_UP_DOWN.session_rule: one target per exchange session at the registered close decision time; only the next official session close supplies the target
POS_1D_UP_DOWN.flat_rule: exclude rows with absolute simple return <= 1e-8; count exclusions by fold and source
POS_1D_UP_DOWN.missing_target_rule: exclude missing decision/target price rows and report count; gate BLOCK if >1.0% of session-eligible rows lack the target pair

chronological_validation.session_interpretation: Calendar boundaries above are fixed. Only actual official exchange sessions with eligible source rows count; no fold boundary may be shifted to improve sample size.
chronological_validation.training: for each fold, train on all eligible observations from 2021-10-11 up to the pre-validation boundary using an expanding window; previous validation periods may enter later folds' training only after their targets are fully known and all transformations are refit from scratch.
chronological_validation.purge_rule: Exclude training examples whose label interval intersects the outer validation window; additionally remove the final complete exchange session immediately before each validation window from training.
chronological_validation.embargo_rule: Exclude the first complete exchange session of each validation window from scored validation predictions. Apply a separate inner chronological purge/embargo around all tuning/calibration folds.
chronological_validation.horizon_end_rule: Score a validation label only when its target endpoint is within the same registered validation window and within dataset date bounds.
chronological_validation.final_untouched_holdout: NOT INCLUDED in this registry sample; reserved for a separately authorized fresh-forward phase. Do not use these folds to tune after review.

inner_validation.split_policy: Within each outer training window, sort eligible official exchange sessions and form three expanding inner folds with validation intervals at session-index quantiles [0.40, 0.60), [0.60, 0.80), and [0.80, 1.00). Each inner fold trains only on earlier sessions and applies the same one-session purge and embargo.
inner_validation.calibration: Build training-only out-of-fold predictions from these three inner folds; fit calibrators and abstention/gating thresholds only on these out-of-fold predictions. Refit the final family estimator on the full eligible outer-training set after calibration choices are frozen.
inner_validation.if_any_inner_fold_fails: Block that config/fold before fitting; do not silently change the split or use a random split.

sample_eligibility.common_panel: Within each label stratum and outer fold, all compatible candidates use the same decision rows. Feature values are imputed with training-fold-only statistics; do not silently drop rows candidate-by-candidate.
sample_eligibility.feature_missingness_rule: Within each training fold, median-impute numeric features and add a missingness indicator using training rows only. If a feature exceeds 20% missingness or all values are missing, exclude it. If more than 20% of registered features in a representation are excluded, block that representation/configuration before fitting.
sample_eligibility.infinities: convert +/- infinity to missing, then apply the registered training-only missingness rule; report counts
sample_eligibility.duplicates: deduplicate only byte-identical (instrument, exchange timestamp, interval) rows; conflicting duplicates block the affected source/fold pending reconciliation
sample_eligibility.fail_closed: If any fold/stratum fails row, class-support, coverage, timestamp or missingness minima, mark that fold/config BLOCKED_SAMPLE_ELIGIBILITY; do not relax rules or substitute a later date window.

fitting_and_calibration.preprocessing: Fit imputation, scaling, feature selection, dimensionality reduction, regime thresholds, class priors and all target-dependent transforms on training rows only.
fitting_and_calibration.inner_validation: Use deterministic expanding inner chronological folds contained wholly in the current outer training window. Each inner validation fold has one-session purge and embargo; no random row split.
fitting_and_calibration.hyperparameters: Only the frozen configuration fields in the committed config shard may be used; no ad-hoc tuning or model-family substitution.
fitting_and_calibration.probability_calibration: Native probabilities when family contract proves semantics; otherwise train-only Platt calibration on predictions made out-of-fold within inner chronological folds. No outer-validation targets used to fit or choose calibration.
fitting_and_calibration.prevalence_baseline: Training-fold positive prevalence with fixed Jeffreys smoothing p=(n_positive+0.5)/(n_train+1), then clip to [1e-6,1-1e-6]; baseline is scored on exactly the same common evaluation rows as candidate.

abstention_operator.cutoff_rule: 80th percentile of predictive Bernoulli entropy estimated from inner chronological training out-of-fold predictions; never estimate cutoff on outer validation data

bootstrap.method: paired moving-block bootstrap over exchange sessions; resample contiguous five-session blocks with replacement, applying the same resampled session indices to candidate and baseline
bootstrap.confidence_interval: percentile interval of paired mean log-loss improvement across replicates
bootstrap.raw_p_value: center bootstrap replicates under the null by subtracting observed improvement; two-sided p=(1 + count(|centered_delta| >= |observed_delta|))/(B+1)
bootstrap.resampling_unit: exchange sessions within each outer validation fold; moving blocks never cross fold boundaries; each replicate resamples contiguous five-session blocks independently within each fold and reuses the same row indices for candidate and baseline.

multiplicity.family_definition: one fixed testing family per label stratum, comprising every pre-registered configuration that passes the pre-result compatibility and sample-eligibility gates for that label; family membership freezes before any outer-validation metric is computed
multiplicity.order_of_operations: freeze eligible configuration membership, compute paired block-bootstrap raw p-values, apply BY within each label stratum, and report all configurations including rejected/blocked entries
multiplicity.count_basis: Current draft matrix marks 426/1000 method rows ALLOW_IN_PRINCIPLE and every row remains execution-blocked. Four label-specific configurations per method imply an upper bound of 1704 hypotheses per label; actual BY family membership is frozen after pre-result compatibility/sample screening. Any matrix change before fitting requires a new hash-pinned preregistration/tester approval.

metrics_and_inference.primary_effect_direction: positive baseline_log_loss - candidate_log_loss means candidate improves on baseline

output_and_failure_rules.technical_failures: Persist one JSONL record with config/fold/step/exception and traceback hash; do not retry with altered inputs silently.
output_and_failure_rules.encrypted_data: This preregistration consumes only a dataset artifact whose decryption/access gate is separately authorized. The committed manifest currently declares encrypted_only=true; no decryption or row access is performed by this specification builder.
output_and_failure_rules.holdout_protection: No untouched holdout path/secret is read or written by R2 tooling.

gate: DRAFT ONLY. These choices are frozen as a proposed protocol file for independent tester review. No empirical fitting until the tester independently approves this preregistration, the compatibility matrix, adapter tests and synthetic restart/resource evidence.
